newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan stocks seen struggling in range-trading.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan stocks seen struggling in range-trading.

text.p: Taiwan share prices are expected to consolidate on Wednesday amid a lack of market-moving factors, brokers said.
On Tuesday, the index ended 71.40 points or 0.87 percent lower at 8,123.26. A 8,050-8,200 range was seen for Wednesday.
"Investors in general still adopt a wait-and-see attitude amid a lack of market-moving factors," said Nomura Securities analyst Amy Huang.
"With turnover slowed, the index has no back-up to test resistance at 8,250."
Brokers said the market likely would not react to newspaper reports that the economics ministry has set up a ceiling for single investments by local firms in China at US$50 million.
"A stricter rule on China investment is already well expected, so it should not dampen the market," Huang said.
